_how_to_add_a_real_review: Add a real review by copying an entry and filling every field. It appears on the live site only when placeholder is false AND permission is true AND source, rating, headline and text are filled. headline = the one-line turning point (shown as the pull-quote). situation = filter group (Solo bookkeeper, Firm, One-off). metric = optional short result like '40 min to 3 min'. verified = true only if you confirmed they paid or used it. Never write a review yourself. Entries with placeholder true show ONLY at ?previewReviews=1 and never in search-engine markup.
